description: [security] Delegation-depth + KL gate (GOV-100). Reads chain_depth and kl_divergence. It does NOT read your data description and does NOT evaluate GDPR/CCPA - compliant:true only means the delegation chain is shallow and KL is under epsilon.

chain_depth.description: Delegation chain depth. Higher = deeper hand-off. Past the gate threshold the result escalates to quarantine_escalation.

description.description: Free text. Accepted for readability and IGNORED by the gate. It never changes the verdict.

kl_divergence.description: eps_KL divergence of the current policy from baseline. Above epsilon fails the gate.

name: compliance_check
title: Compliance Check
